# Milwaukee Bucks 2026/27 NBA Season Preview: A New Era Begins

Locked On Fantasy Basketball, 2026-08-14, 39:06. https://youtu.be/owlM6b8oUd0

## Summary

Josh Lloyd and Justin Garcia of the Locked On Bucks podcast preview the 2026/27 Milwaukee Bucks after Giannis Antetokounmpo was traded to Miami for Tyler Herro, Kel'el Ware, Jaime Jaquez Jr. and Kasparas Jakucionis. The roster is too big at 17 players and is heavy on guards. Pete Nance and Caris LeVert look like the easiest cuts, and the Bucks may still trade for Peyton Watson. Justin's projected starting five is Rollins, Herro, Jaquez, Ware and Turner. He expects Ryan Rollins to score about 20 points per game under new coach Taylor Jenkins and Herro to lead the team in scoring. Kevin Porter Jr. looks pushed down the rotation, and Myles Turner's bad year is blamed partly on how Doc Rivers used him. Justin expects a faster team that crashes the offensive glass and forces turnovers, and he projects about 33 wins against a line of 26.5.

  > "it is not common, for that to be an annual occurrence that you are hitting all those types of shots."
- [22:16](https://youtu.be/owlM6b8oUd0?t=1336) A big man's production in the pick and roll depends on having a real point guard. Bad guard play can hold back a center.
  > "point guard play is vital to Miles Turner when you think about the pick and roll and everything else."
- [35:23](https://youtu.be/owlM6b8oUd0?t=2123) A coaching change can change a team's style. The new style can affect stat environments such as offensive rebounds, steals and pace.
  > "I think they're going to be more of a pressure style defense as well to force turnovers."
- [12:36](https://youtu.be/owlM6b8oUd0?t=756) A strong option or extension decision by a team signals how much it believes in a player. A player who simply picks up his option may not be in the long-term plans.
  > "If you truly believed in him as starting caliber player, you're working out an extension with him this summer"
